Public WithEvents Book As Workbook

Private Sub Book_SheetBeforeDoubleClick(ByVal Sh As Object, ByVal Target As Range, Cancel As Boolean)
    Log = Log & "[BeforeDoubleClick " & Sh.Name & " " & Target.Address(False, False) & " " & Cancel & "]"
    If WantCancel Then Cancel = True
End Sub

Private Sub Book_SheetChange(ByVal Sh As Object, ByVal Target As Range)
    Log = Log & "[Change " & Sh.Name & " " & Target.Address(False, False) & "]"
End Sub

Private Sub Book_SheetSelectionChange(ByVal Sh As Object, ByVal Target As Range)
    Log = Log & "[SelectionChange " & Sh.Name & " " & Target.Address(False, False) & "]"
End Sub

Private Sub Book_NewSheet(ByVal Sh As Object)
    Log = Log & "[NewSheet " & Sh.Name & "]"
End Sub

Private Sub Book_SheetActivate(ByVal Sh As Object)
    Log = Log & "[Activate " & Sh.Name & "]"
End Sub

Private Function Digest(wb As Workbook) As String
    Dim s As String, sh As Worksheet, cell As Range
    On Error Resume Next
    s = "ready " & Application.Ready & " visible " & Application.Visible & " sheets"
    For Each sh In wb.Worksheets
        s = s & " " & sh.Name
    Next
    s = s & " active " & ActiveSheet.Name & "!" & ActiveCell.Address(False, False) & " sel " & Selection.Address(False, False)
    For Each cell In wb.Worksheets(wb.Worksheets.Count).Range("A1:F8")
        If Not IsEmpty(cell.Value) Then s = s & " " & cell.Address(False, False) & "=" & cell.Text
    Next
    Digest = s
End Function

Function Probe(ByVal which As Long, ByVal cancels As Boolean) As String
    Dim sink As New ExcelSink, wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, pt As PivotTable, r As Variant, failure As String
    Application.EnableEvents = False
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    ws.Activate
    Set sink.Book = wb
    Log = ""
    WantCancel = cancels
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        ws.Range("A1").Select: Application.EnableEvents = True: Application.DoubleClick
    Case 1
        ws.Range("A1").Value = 5: ws.Range("A1").Select: Application.EnableEvents = True: Application.DoubleClick
    Case 2
        ws.Range("A1").Formula = "=1+1": ws.Range("A1").Select: Application.EnableEvents = True: Application.DoubleClick
    Case 3
        ws.Range("A1").Value = 5: ws.Range("A1").Select: Application.EnableEvents = True: Application.DoubleClick
    Case 4
        ws.Range("A1:B5").Value = ws.Evaluate("{""k"",""v"";""a"",1;""b"",2;""a"",3;""b"",4}"): Set pt = wb.PivotCaches.Create(xlDatabase, ws.Range("A1:B5")).CreatePivotTable(ws.Range("D1"), "P"): pt.PivotFields("k").Orientation = xlRowField: pt.AddDataField pt.PivotFields("v"), "Sum of v", xlSum: ws.Range("E2").Select: Application.EnableEvents = True: Application.DoubleClick
    Case 5
        ws.Range("A1:B5").Value = ws.Evaluate("{""k"",""v"";""a"",1;""b"",2;""a"",3;""b"",4}"): Set pt = wb.PivotCaches.Create(xlDatabase, ws.Range("A1:B5")).CreatePivotTable(ws.Range("D1"), "P"): pt.PivotFields("k").Orientation = xlRowField: pt.AddDataField pt.PivotFields("v"), "Sum of v", xlSum: ws.Range("E2").Select: Application.EnableEvents = True: Application.DoubleClick
    Case 6
        ws.Range("A1:B5").Value = ws.Evaluate("{""k"",""v"";""a"",1;""b"",2;""a"",3;""b"",4}"): Set pt = wb.PivotCaches.Create(xlDatabase, ws.Range("A1:B5")).CreatePivotTable(ws.Range("D1"), "P"): pt.PivotFields("k").Orientation = xlRowField: pt.AddDataField pt.PivotFields("v"), "Sum of v", xlSum: ws.Range("E2").Select: Application.DoubleClick
    Case 7
        ws.Range("A1:B5").Value = ws.Evaluate("{""k"",""v"";""a"",1;""b"",2;""a"",3;""b"",4}"): Set pt = wb.PivotCaches.Create(xlDatabase, ws.Range("A1:B5")).CreatePivotTable(ws.Range("D1"), "P"): pt.PivotFields("k").Orientation = xlRowField: pt.AddDataField pt.PivotFields("v"), "Sum of v", xlSum: ws.Range("E4").Select: Application.EnableEvents = True: Application.DoubleClick
    Case 8
        ws.Range("A1:B2").Select: ws.Range("B2").Activate: Application.EnableEvents = True: Application.DoubleClick
    Case 9
        ws.Range("A1").Value = 5: ws.Range("A1").Select: Application.EnableEvents = True: Application.DoubleClick: Application.DoubleClick
    Case 10
        ws.ListObjects.Add xlSrcRange, ws.Range("A1:B3"), , xlYes: ws.Range("A2").Select: Application.EnableEvents = True: Application.DoubleClick
    End Select
Answered:
    On Error GoTo 0
    Application.EnableEvents = False
    Probe = Log & "|" & CStr(r) & failure & "|" & Digest(wb)
    Application.EnableEvents = True
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    failure = "!E" & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    Resume Answered
End Function
